task.ques: Look up the tour about how to use the 'pipeline' feature in the Hugging Face Transformers library for sentiment analysis, and identify the default model it uses.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: The default sentiment-analysis model is distilbert-base-uncased-finetuned-sst-2-english (DistilBERT, fine-tuned on SST-2).

Hugging Face’s Transformers v4.10.1 “Quick tour,” under “Getting started on a task with a pipeline,” shows pipeline('sentiment-analysis') and explicitly names this as the model downloaded by default.
Source: https://huggingface.co/transformers/v4.10.1/quicktour.html#getting-started-on-a-task-with-a-pipeline
Evidence screenshot: final.png
